author: Jessica Thompson
title: Trump Blames Illegal Immigration for Crime Surge - NewsBreak
text:
By Jessica Thompson ,
20 minutes ago President Donald Trump has tied immigration enforcement failures to the killing of Dallas motel manager Chandra Mouli Nagamallaiah, arguing that the Cuban national suspect should not have been in the U.S. Critics, however, pointed to lapses in federal supervision and removal procedures. ICE has since lodged a detainer, and the suspect now faces capital murder charges.
Dallas police had quickly identified Yordanis Cobos-Martinez as the suspect. He is now being held in Dallas County Jail.
Dallas police allege Cobos-Martinez fatally attacked Nagamallaiah with a machete at a motel, in front of his wife and son. An arrest affidavit cites severe injuries consistent with a beheading, with investigators collecting physical and witness evidence. Court records show Cobos-Martinez has a long arrest history, including child indecency and grand theft auto charges that were dropped or acquitted. Trump blamed past immigration policies for his presence, praised enforcement officials, and urged stricter prosecutions and removals.
Trump wrote, “I am aware of the terrible reports regarding the murder of Chandra Nagamallaiah, a well respected person in Dallas, Texas, who was brutally beheaded, in front of his wife and son, by an ILLEGAL ALIEN from Cuba who should have never been in our Country.”
Trump said, “This individual was previously arrested for terrible crimes, including child sex abuse, grand theft auto and false imprisonment, but was released back into our homeland under incompetent Joe Biden because Cuba did not want such an evil person in their country. Rest assured, the time for being soft on the illegal immigrant criminals is OVER under my watch!”
ICE reported Cobos-Martinez was held at Bluebonnet Detention Center and released under supervision after Cuban authorities refused his return. A former Biden official reported that the supervision order was issued shortly before former President Joe Biden left office.
Jessica Thompson covers U.S. politics & news for content partner Modern Newsstand LLC.
